scheme.title: Climate Data Hub Climate Scenario Vocabulary
scheme.description: Experiment ids for `climate.scenarios`, generated from the WCRP CMIP6 controlled vocabulary and the CMIP5 experiment facet of the ESGF search index. Ids are the CMIP spelling verbatim.

source_schemes.title: ESGF search index, CMIP5 project facets

concepts.label: 1pctCO2
concepts.description: DECK: 1pctCO2

concepts.label: 1pctCO2-4xext
concepts.description: branched from 1pctCO2 run at year 140 and run with CO2 fixed at 4x pre-industrial concentration

concepts.label: 1pctCO2-bgc
concepts.description: Biogeochemically-coupled specified concentration simulation in which CO2 increases at a rate of 1% per year until quadrupling

concepts.label: 1pctCO2-cdr
concepts.description: 1 percent per year decrease in CO2 (immediately after reaching 4xCO2 in the 1pctCO2 simulation); then held constant at pre-industrial level (part of the CDR-reversibility experiment)

concepts.label: 1pctCO2-rad
concepts.description: Radiatively-coupled specified concentration simulation in which CO2 increases at a rate of 1% per year until quadrupling

concepts.label: 1pctCO2Ndep
concepts.description: Fully-coupled specified concentration simulation in which CO2 increases at a rate of 1% per year until quadrupling, plus an additional scenario of anthropogenic nitrogen deposition

concepts.label: 1pctCO2Ndep-bgc
concepts.description: Biogeochemically-coupled specified concentration simulation in which CO2 increases at a rate of 1% per year until quadrupling, plus an additional scenario of anthropogenic nitrogen deposition

concepts.label: 1pctCO2to4x-withism
concepts.description: Idealized 1%/yr CO2 increase to 4xC02 over 140yrs and kept constant at 4xCO2 for an additional 200 to 400 yrs simulation that includes interactive ice sheets

concepts.label: a4SST
concepts.description: As piSST, but with monthly-varying SSTs taken from years 111-140 of each model's own abrupt-4xCO2 experiment instead of from piControl. Sea-ice is unchanged from piSST

concepts.label: a4SSTice
concepts.description: As piSST, but with monthly-varying SSTs and sea-ice taken from years 111-140 of each model's own abrupt-4xCO2 experiment instead of from piControl

concepts.label: a4SSTice-4xCO2
concepts.description: As a4SSTice, but CO2 is quadrupled, and the increase in CO2 is seen by both the radiation scheme and vegetation

concepts.label: abrupt-0p5xCO2
concepts.description: Identical to the DECK abrupt-4xCO2, but at 0.5xCO2

concepts.label: abrupt-2xCO2
concepts.description: Identical to the DECK abrupt-4xCO2, but at 2xCO2

concepts.label: abrupt-4xCO2
concepts.description: DECK: abrupt-4xCO2

concepts.label: abrupt-solm4p
concepts.description: Conceptually similar to abrupt 4xCO2 DECK experiment, except that the solar constant rather than CO2 is abruptly reduced by 4%

concepts.label: abrupt-solp4p
concepts.description: Conceptually similar to abrupt 4xCO2 DECK experiment, except that the solar constant rather than CO2 is abruptly increased by 4%

concepts.label: amip
concepts.description: DECK: AMIP

concepts.label: amip-4xCO2
concepts.description: As CMIP5/CFMIP-2 amip4xCO2 experiment. AMIP experiment where SSTs are held at control values and the CO2 seen by the radiation scheme is quadrupled

concepts.label: amip-a4SST-4xCO2
concepts.description: Same as amip, but a patterned SST anomaly is applied on top of the monthly-varying amip SSTs. This anomaly is a monthly climatology, taken from each model's own abrupt-4xCO2 run minus piControl (using the mean of years 111-140 of abrupt-4xCO2, and the parallel 30-year section of piControl). CO2 is quadrupled, and the increase in CO2 is seen by both the radiation scheme and vegetation

concepts.label: amip-climSIC
concepts.description: PA5.2: investigate role of transient SST in recent climate change

concepts.label: amip-climSST
concepts.description: PA5.1: investigate role of transient sea ice in recent climate change

concepts.label: amip-future4K
concepts.description: As CMIP5/CFMIP-2 amipFuture experiment. AMIP experiment where SSTs are subject to a composite SST warming pattern derived from coupled models, scaled to an ice-free ocean mean of 4K

concepts.label: amip-hist
concepts.description: Extended AMIP run that covers 1870-2014. All natural and anthropogenic historical forcings as used in CMIP6 Historical Simulation will be included. AGCM resolution as CMIP6 Historical Simulation. The HadISST data will be used

concepts.label: amip-hld
concepts.description: The topography of the highlands in Africa, N. America and S. America TP is modified by setting surface elevations to a certain height (500m). Same model as DECK

concepts.label: amip-lfmip-pdLC
concepts.description: Scenario forced experiment with prescribed land surface climatology derived from modern conditions from the first historical ensemble member (1980-2014). SST and sea-ice from the first ensemble members of the historical and ssp585 experiments

concepts.label: amip-lfmip-pObs
concepts.description: Land-hist land conditions; AMIP SSTs

concepts.label: amip-lfmip-rmLC
concepts.description: Scenario forced experiment with prescribed land surface climatology derived from 30yr running mean from the first ensemble members of the historical and ssp585 experiments. SST and sea-ice from the first ensemble members of the historical and ssp585 experiments

concepts.label: amip-lwoff
concepts.description: As amip experiment, but with cloud-radiative effects switched off in the LW radiation code

concepts.label: amip-m4K
concepts.description: As amip experiment but SSTs are subject to a uniform cooling of 4K

concepts.label: amip-p4K
concepts.description: As CMIP5/CFMIP-2 amip4K experiment. AMIP experiment where SSTs are subject to a uniform warming of 4K

concepts.label: amip-p4K-lwoff
concepts.description: As amip-p4K experiment, but with cloud-radiative effects switched off in the LW radiation code

concepts.label: amip-piForcing
concepts.description: Identical to standard AMIP experiment but from 1870-present with constant pre-industrial forcing levels (anthropogenic and natural)

concepts.label: amip-TIP
concepts.description: The topography of the TIP is modified by setting surface elevations to 500m; to understand the combined thermal and mechanical forcing of the TIP. Same model as DECK

concepts.label: amip-TIP-nosh
concepts.description: Surface sensible heat released at the elevation above 500m over the TIP is not allowed to heat the atmosphere. Same model as DECK

concepts.label: aqua-4xCO2
concepts.description: Extended version of CMIP5/CFMIP-2 aqua4xCO2 experiment. Aquaplanet experiment where SSTs are held at control values and the CO2 seen by the radiation scheme is quadrupled

concepts.label: aqua-control
concepts.description: Extended version of CMIP5/CFMIP-2 aquaControl experiment. Aquaplanet (no land) experiment with no seasonal cycle forced with specified zonally symmetric SSTs

concepts.label: aqua-control-lwoff
concepts.description: As aqua-control experiment, but with cloud-radiative effects switched off in the LW radiation code

concepts.label: aqua-p4K
concepts.description: Extended version of CMIP5/CFMIP-2 aqua4K experiment. Aquaplanet experiment where SSTs are subject to a uniform warming of 4K

concepts.label: aqua-p4K-lwoff
concepts.description: As aqua-p4K experiment, but with cloud-radiative effects switched off in the LW radiation code

concepts.label: control-1950
concepts.description: Coupled integrations with constant 1950"s forcing

concepts.label: control-slab
concepts.description: slab control run for volc-pinatubo-slab

concepts.label: dcppA-assim
concepts.description: A2.3 Assimilation runs used to generate initial conditions for hindcasts

concepts.label: dcppA-hindcast
concepts.description: A1 (and A2.1, A3.1, and A3.2) Decadal hindcasts begun near the end of each year from 1960 to 2019, or every other year at minimum. First full hindcast year follows start year (e.g., for s1960, first full hindcast year is 1961)

concepts.label: dcppA-hindcast-niff
concepts.description: A4.1 Decadal hindcasts begun near the end of each year from 1960 to 2019, or every other year at minimum, but with no information from the future. First full hindcast year follows start year (e.g., for s1960, first full hindcast year is 1961)

concepts.label: dcppA-historical-niff
concepts.description: A4.2 Hindcasts initialized from historical climate simulations as in DCPP-A2.2, but with no information from the future. First full hindcast year follows start year (e.g., for s1960, first full hindcast year is 1961)

concepts.label: dcppB-forecast
concepts.description: B1 (and B2.1, B2.2) Ongoing decadal forecasts. First full forecast year follows start year (e.g., for s2017, first full forecast year is 2018)

concepts.label: dcppC-amv-ExTrop-neg
concepts.description: C1.7 Mechanisms and predictability of the hiatus and of similar long timescale variations of both signs

concepts.label: dcppC-amv-ExTrop-pos
concepts.description: C1.7Mechanisms and predictability of the hiatus and of similar long timescale variations of both signs

concepts.label: dcppC-amv-neg
concepts.description: C1.3 Mechanisms and predictability of the hiatus and of similar long timescale variations of both signs

concepts.label: dcppC-amv-pos
concepts.description: C1.2 Mechanisms and predictability of the hiatus and of similar long timescale variations of both signs

concepts.label: dcppC-amv-Trop-neg
concepts.description: C1.8 Mechanisms and predictability of the hiatus and of similar long timescale variations of both signs

concepts.label: dcppC-amv-Trop-pos
concepts.description: C1.8 Mechanisms and predictability of the hiatus and of similar long timescale variations of both signs

concepts.label: dcppC-atl-control
concepts.description: C1.1 Mechanisms and predictability of the hiatus and of similar long timescale variations of both signs

concepts.label: dcppC-atl-pacemaker
concepts.description: C1.11 Mechanisms and predictability of the hiatus and of similar long timescale variations of both signs

concepts.label: dcppC-atl-spg
concepts.description: C2.1 (and C2.2) Mechanisms and predictability of the hiatus and of similar long timescale variations of both signs. First full hindcast year follows start year (e.g., for s1992, first full hindcast year is 1993)

concepts.label: dcppC-forecast-addAgung
concepts.description: C3.4 Effects of volcanoes on decadal prediction and predictability of forced and internal variability components. First full hindcast year is 2015

concepts.label: dcppC-forecast-addElChichon
concepts.description: C3.5 Effects of volcanoes on decadal prediction and predictability of forced and internal variability components. First full hindcast year is 2015

concepts.label: dcppC-forecast-addPinatubo
concepts.description: C3.6 Effects of volcanoes on decadal prediction and predictability of forced and internal variability components. First full hindcast year is 2015

concepts.label: dcppC-hindcast-noAgung
concepts.description: C3.3 Effects of volcanoes on decadal prediction and predictability of forced and internal variability components. First full hindcast year is 1962

concepts.label: dcppC-hindcast-noElChichon
concepts.description: C3.2 Effects of volcanoes on decadal prediction and predictability of forced and internal variability components. First full hindcast year is 1982

concepts.label: dcppC-hindcast-noPinatubo
concepts.description: C3.1 Effects of volcanoes on decadal prediction and predictability of forced and internal variability components. First full hindcast year is 1991

concepts.label: dcppC-ipv-neg
concepts.description: C1.6 Mechanisms and predictability of the hiatus and of similar long timescale variations of both signs

concepts.label: dcppC-ipv-NexTrop-neg
concepts.description: C1.9 and predictability of the hiatus and of similar long timescale variations of both signs

concepts.label: dcppC-ipv-NexTrop-pos
concepts.description: C1.9 Mechanisms and predictability of the hiatus and of similar long timescale variations of both signs

concepts.label: dcppC-ipv-pos
concepts.description: C1.5 Mechanisms and predictability of the hiatus and of similar long timescale variations of both signs

concepts.label: dcppC-pac-control
concepts.description: C1.4 Mechanisms and predictability of the hiatus and of similar long timescale variations of both signs

concepts.label: dcppC-pac-pacemaker
concepts.description: C1.10 Mechanisms and predictability of the hiatus and of similar long timescale variations of both signs. First full hindcast year is 2015

concepts.label: deforest-globe
concepts.description: Idealized deforestation experiment, 20 million km2 forest removed linearly over a period of 50 years, with an additional 30 years with no specified change in forest cover; all other forcings held constant

concepts.label: esm-1pct-brch-1000PgC
concepts.description: A zero-emissions simulation (fully interactive CO2; emissions-driven configuration), initiated from the point in the 1pctCO2 experiment when the cumulative carbon emissions reach 1000 PgC

concepts.label: esm-1pct-brch-2000PgC
concepts.description: A zero-emissions simulation (fully interactive CO2; emissions-driven configuration), initiated from the point in the 1pctCO2 experiment when the cumulative carbon emissions reach 2000 PgC

concepts.label: esm-1pct-brch-750PgC
concepts.description: A zero-emissions simulation (fully interactive CO2; emissions-driven configuration), initiated from the point in the 1pctCO2 experiment when the cumulative carbon emissions reach 750 PgC

concepts.label: esm-1pctCO2
concepts.description: An emissions-driven simulation (fully interactive CO2), initiated from the esm-piControl using CO2 emissions diagnosed from the 1pctCO2 experiment so that the emissions-driven run replicates as closely as possible the 1pctCO2 concentration profile

concepts.label: esm-bell-1000PgC
concepts.description: An emissions-driven simulation (fully interactive CO2), initiated from esm-piControl using CO2 emissions, amounting to 1000 PgC, following a bell-shape curve for 100 years followed by zero-emissions for 100 years

concepts.label: esm-bell-2000PgC
concepts.description: An emissions-driven simulation (fully interactive CO2), initiated from esm-piControl using CO2 emissions, amounting to 2000 PgC, following a bell-shape curve for 100 years followed by zero-emissions for 100 years

concepts.label: esm-bell-750PgC
concepts.description: An emissions-driven simulation (fully interactive CO2), initiated from esm-piControl using CO2 emissions, amounting to 750 PgC, following a bell-shape curve for 100 years followed by zero-emissions for 100 years

concepts.label: esm-hist
concepts.description: CMIP6 historical (CO2 emission-driven)

concepts.label: esm-hist-ext
concepts.description: Extension beyond 2014 of the CMIP6 historical (CO2 emission-driven)

concepts.label: esm-past1000
concepts.description: Parallel experiment to past1000, but for model set-ups with interactive carbon cycle. Main forcings: trace gases, volcanoes, solar variability, land-use

concepts.label: esm-pi-cdr-pulse
concepts.description: 100 Gt C instantly removed (negative pulse) from a pre-industrial atmosphere (part of the CDR-pi-pulse experiment)

concepts.label: esm-pi-CO2pulse
concepts.description: 100 Gt C instantly added (positive pulse) to a pre-industrial atmosphere (part of the CDR-pi-pulse experiment)

concepts.label: esm-piControl
concepts.description: DECK: control (emission-driven)

concepts.label: esm-piControl-spinup
concepts.description: DECK: spin-up portion of the control (emission-driven)

concepts.label: esm-ssp534-over
concepts.description: CO2 emissions driven SSP5-3.4 overshoot scenario simulation optionally extending to year 2300 (part of the CDR-overshoot experiment)

concepts.label: esm-ssp585
concepts.description: Emissions-driven future scenario simulation

concepts.label: esm-ssp585-ocn-alk
concepts.description: emission driven SSP5-8.5 scenario with 0.14 Pmol/yr alkalinity added to ice free ocean surface waters from 2020 optionally extended from 2100 to 2300 (part of the CDR-ocean-alk experiment)

concepts.label: esm-ssp585-ocn-alk-stop
concepts.description: Simulation of abrupt termination of ocean alkalinsation in 2070 during an emission driven SSP5-8.5 scenario (part of the CDR-ocean-alk experiment)

concepts.label: esm-ssp585-ssp126Lu
concepts.description: Additional land use policy sensitivity simulation for high radiative forcing scenario, keep all forcings the same as in C4MIP esmssp5-8.5 scenario except use SSP1-2.6 land use; emission driven

concepts.label: esm-ssp585-ssp126Lu-ext
concepts.description: Long term extension of CO2 emissions driven SSP5-8.5 with SSP1-2.6 land use forcing (part of the CDR-afforestation experiment)

concepts.label: esm-ssp585ext
concepts.description: Long term extension of CO2 emissions driven SSP5-8.5 scenario (used in the CDR-afforestation and CDR-ocean-alk experiments)

concepts.label: esm-yr2010CO2-cdr-pulse
concepts.description: Upon initialization from end of year 2015 of esm-yr2010CO2-control instantaneously remove 100 Gt C ("negative pulse"; part of the CDR-yr2010-pulse experiment

concepts.label: esm-yr2010CO2-CO2pulse
concepts.description: Upon initialization from end of year 2015 of esm-yr2010CO2-control instantaneously introduce 100 Gt C ("positive pulse"; part of the CDR-yr2010-pulse experiment)

concepts.label: esm-yr2010CO2-control
concepts.description: Forced with CO2 emissions diagnosed from historical and yr2010CO2 simulations and all other forcings the same as in that simulation (part of the CDR-yr2010-pulse experiment)

concepts.label: esm-yr2010CO2-noemit
concepts.description: Upon initialization from end of year 2015 of esm-yr2010-control CO2 emissions are fixed at zero; all other forcing fixed at 2010 level (part of the CDR-yr2010-pulse experiment)

concepts.label: faf-all
concepts.description: 1xCO2 experiment, parallel to piControl, forced over the ocean simultaneously by surface windstress (as in the wind experiment), net heat flux (as in the heat experiment) and net freshwater flux (as in the water experiment) anomalies obtained from the CMIP5 ensemble mean of 1pctCO2 experiments at the time of 2xCO2, using a passive tracer to prevent negative climate feedback on the heat flux applied

concepts.label: faf-antwater-stress
concepts.description: 1xCO2 experiment, parallel to piControl, forced over the ocean with the momentum flux perturbation field of faf-stress and a surface freshwater flux of 0.1 Sv in total to be applied uniformly around the coast of Antarctica in whatever way is most suitable in the model

concepts.label: faf-heat
concepts.description: 1xCO2 experiment, parallel to piControl, forced over the ocean by surface net heat flux anomalies obtained from the CMIP5 ensemble mean of 1pctCO2 experiments at the time of 2xCO2, using a passive tracer to prevent negative climate feedback on the heat flux applied

concepts.label: faf-heat-NA0pct
concepts.description: 1xCO2 experiment, parallel to piControl, forced over the ocean by the same method and with the same surface net heat flux perturbation field as in faf-heat, except that within part of the North Atlantic ocean the perturbation is zero

concepts.label: faf-heat-NA50pct
concepts.description: 1xCO2 experiment, parallel to piControl, forced over the ocean by the same method and with the same surface net heat flux perturbation field as in faf-heat, except that within part of the North Atlantic ocean the perturbation is multiplied by 0.5

concepts.label: faf-passiveheat
concepts.description: 1xCO2 experiment, parallel to piControl, with a flux of passive tracer added at the ocean surface at the same rate as the surface net heat flux anomaly applied in the FAFMIP heat experiment

concepts.label: faf-stress
concepts.description: 1xCO2 experiment, parallel to piControl, forced over the ocean by surface windstress anomalies obtained from the CMIP5 ensemble mean of 1pctCO2 experiments at the time of 2xCO2

concepts.label: faf-water
concepts.description: 1xCO2 experiment, parallel to piControl, forced over the ocean by surface net freshwater flux anomalies obtained from the CMIP5 ensemble mean of 1pctCO2 experiments at the time of 2xCO2

concepts.label: futSST-pdSIC
concepts.description: PA1.4: investigate role of SST in polar amplification

concepts.label: futureSST-4xCO2-solar
concepts.description: Time slice at year 100 of G1ext to examine radiative forcing of abrupt-4xCO2 and G1

concepts.label: G1
concepts.description: Beginning from a preindustrial control run, simultaneously quadruple the CO2 concentration and reduce the solar constant such that the TOA radiative flux remains within +/m0.1 W/m2

concepts.label: G6solar
concepts.description: Using solar irradiance reduction, return the radiative forcing from a background of the ScenarioMIP high forcing to the ScenarioMIP middle forcing

concepts.label: G6SST1
concepts.description: Time slice at 2020 (ScenarioMIP Tier 1 high forcing scenario)

concepts.label: G6SST2-solar
concepts.description: Time slice at 2100 (G6solar)

concepts.label: G6SST2-sulfur
concepts.description: Time slice at 2100 (G6sulfur)

concepts.label: G6sulfur
concepts.description: Using equatorial SO2 injection, return the radiative forcing from a background of the ScenarioMIP high forcing to the ScenarioMIP middle forcing

concepts.label: G7cirrus
concepts.description: Against a background of the ScenarioMIP high forcing, reduce cirrus cloud optical depth by a constant amount

concepts.label: G7SST1-cirrus
concepts.description: Time slice at 2020 (ScenarioMIP Tier 1 high forcing scenario and cirrus thinning according to G7cirrus)

concepts.label: G7SST2-cirrus
concepts.description: Time slice at 2100 (ScenarioMIP Tier 1 high forcing scenario and cirrus thinning according to G7cirrus)

concepts.label: highres-future
concepts.description: Coupled integrations with SSP5 forcing (nearest to CMIP5 RCP8.5 (as in highresSST-future)

concepts.label: highresSST-4xCO2
concepts.description: Similar to CFMIP amip-4xCO2, SSTs are held at highresSST-present values and the CO2 seen by the radiation scheme is quadrupled

concepts.label: highresSST-future
concepts.description: Extend highresSST-present to 2050 with agreed SSP5/RCP8.5 forcings (with option to extend further to 2100)

concepts.label: highresSST-LAI
concepts.description: Forced global atmosphere-land simulations as highresSST-present, but using an common LAI dataset across models

concepts.label: highresSST-p4K
concepts.description: Similar to CFMIP amip-p4K, add a uniform warming of 4K to highresSST-present SSTs and run the experiment parallel to highresSST-present

concepts.label: highresSST-present
concepts.description: Forced global atmosphere-land simulations using daily 1/4 degree SST and sea-ice forcings, and aerosol optical properties (not emissions) to constrain model spread

concepts.label: highresSST-smoothed
concepts.description: Forced global atmosphere-land simulations as highresSST-present, but using smoothed SST to investigate impact of SST variability

concepts.label: hist-1950
concepts.description: Coupled integrations with historic external forcings (as in highresSST-present)

concepts.label: hist-1950HC
concepts.description: Historical WMGHG concentrations and NTCF emissions, 1950 halocarbon concentrations, start 1950

concepts.label: hist-aer
concepts.description: historical anthropogenic aerosols-only run

concepts.label: hist-aer-cmip5
concepts.description: historical anthropogenic aerosols-only run (CMIP5-era historical [1850-2005] and RCP4.5 [2006-2020] forcing)

concepts.label: hist-all-aer2
concepts.description: Historical ALL forcing run with alternate estimates of aerosol concentrations/emissions

concepts.label: hist-all-nat2
concepts.description: Historical ALL forcing run with alternates estimate of solar and volcanic forcing

concepts.label: hist-bgc
concepts.description: Concentration-driven historical simulation, biogeochemically-coupled

concepts.label: hist-CO2
concepts.description: Historical CO2-only run

concepts.label: hist-GHG
concepts.description: Historical well-mixed GHG-only run. Models with interactive chemistry schemes should either turn off the chemistry or use a preindustrial climatology of stratospheric and tropospheric ozone in their radiation schemes. This will ensure that ozone is fixed in all these simulations, and simulated responses in models with and without coupled chemistry are comparable

concepts.label: hist-GHG-cmip5
concepts.description: historical well-mixed GHG-only run. Models with interactive chemistry schemes should either turn off the chemistry or use a preindustrial climatology of stratospheric and tropospheric ozone in their radiation schemes. This will ensure that ozone is fixed in all these simulations, and simulated responses in models with and without coupled chemistry are comparable (CMIP5-era historical [1850-2005] and RCP4.5 [2006-2020] forcing)

concepts.label: hist-nat
concepts.description: Historical natural-only run

concepts.label: hist-nat-cmip5
concepts.description: historical natural-only run (CMIP5-era historical [1850-2005] and RCP4.5 [2006-2020] forcing)

concepts.label: hist-noLu
concepts.description: Same as CMIP6 historical but with land cover held at 1850, no human activity; concentration driven

concepts.label: hist-piAer
concepts.description: Historical WMGHG, halocarbon concentrations and O3 precursor emissions, 1850 aerosol precursor emissions

concepts.label: hist-piNTCF
concepts.description: Historical WMGHG and halocarbons concentrations, 1850 NTCF emissions

concepts.label: hist-resAMO
concepts.description: Pacemaker 20th century historical run that includes all forcing as used in CMIP6 Historical Simulation, and the observational historical SST is restored in the AMO domain (0deg-70degN, 70degW-0deg)

concepts.label: hist-resIPO
concepts.description: Pacemaker 20th century historical run that includes all forcing as used in CMIP6 Historical Simulation, and the observational historical SST is restored in the tropical lobe of the IPO domain (20degS-20degN, 175degE-75degW)

concepts.label: hist-sol
concepts.description: Historical solar-only transient simulation using settings from CMIP6 historical simulation but fixed GHG and ODS (1850 level)

concepts.label: hist-spAer-aer
concepts.description: Prescribed anthropogenic aerosol optical properties. Changes in aerosols only

concepts.label: hist-spAer-all
concepts.description: Prescribed anthropogenic aerosol optical properties. All forcings

concepts.label: hist-stratO3
concepts.description: Historical stratospheric ozone-only. In models with coupled chemistry, the chemistry scheme should be turned off, and the simulated ensemble mean monthly mean 3D stratospheric ozone concentrations from the CMIP6 historical simulations should be prescribed. Tropospheric ozone should be fixed at 3D long-term monthly mean piControl values, with a value of 100 ppbv ozone concentration in this piControl climatology used to separate the troposphere from the stratosphere. In models without coupled chemistry the same stratospheric ozone prescribed in the CMIP6 historical simulations should be prescribed. Stratospheric ozone concentrations will be provided by CCMI

concepts.label: hist-totalO3
concepts.description: Historical total ozone-only. In models with coupled chemistry, the chemistry scheme should be turned off, and the simulated ensemble mean monthly mean 3D ozone concentrations from the CMIP6 historical simulations should be prescribed through the depth of the atmosphere. In models without coupled chemistry the same ozone prescribed in the CMIP6 historical simulations should be prescribed

concepts.label: hist-volc
concepts.description: Historical volcanic-only run

concepts.label: historical
concepts.description: CMIP6 historical

concepts.label: historical-cmip5
concepts.description: CMIP5 historical experiment, using CMIP5-era [1850-2005] forcing

concepts.label: historical-ext
concepts.description: Extension beyond 2014 of the CMIP6 historical

concepts.label: historical-withism
concepts.description: Historical simulation that includes interactive ice sheets. Set up follows the historical experiment

concepts.label: histSST
concepts.description: Historical transient with SSTs prescribed from historical

concepts.label: histSST-1950HC
concepts.description: Historical WMGHG concentrations and NTCF emissions, 1950 halocarbon concentrations

concepts.label: histSST-noLu
concepts.description: An uncoupled (atmosphere and land) experiment in which sea surface temperatures (SST) and sea ice concentrations (SICONC) are taken from historical (as in existing histSST experiment). All forcing agents to follow historical except LULCC. LULCC set to 1850 (exactly following hist-noLu prescription)

concepts.label: histSST-piAer
concepts.description: Historical WMGHG, halocarbon concentrations and tropospheric ozone precursors emissions, 1850 aerosol precursor emissions, prescribed SSTs

concepts.label: histSST-piCH4
concepts.description: Historical (non-CH4) WMGHG concentrations and NTCF emissions, 1850 CH4 concentrations

concepts.label: histSST-piN2O
concepts.description: Historical (non-N2O) WMGHG concentrations and NTCF emissions, 1850 N2O concentrations

concepts.label: omip1
concepts.description: Global ocean - sea-ice coupled experiment forced with the Coordinated Ocean - ice Reference Experiments inter-annually varying atmospheric and river data sets for years 1948-2009. Initial ocean tracer fields are based on observations. Simulation length for at least 5 cycles of the 62-year forcing is required. The 5-cycle length is recommended to facilitate intercomparison within the experiment by using a common simulation length, but a longer simulation length is also accepted. For each simulation, set the beginning of the simulation (e.g., 1700 and 1638 for the 5-cycle and 6-cycle simulation, respectively) as the 'base time' of the time axis. Simulations with different simulation lengths by a single model are treated as members of an ensemble. Thus, different 'realization' indexes (e.g., r1, r2, r3, ...) should be used in a global attribute named 'variant_index' (e.g., r1i1p1f1). It is requested that information relevant to understanding the differences in members of an ensemble of simulations is reported in a global attribute named 'variant_info'. This information should also be recorded in the ES-DOC documentation of each experiment performed by a model and be made available via the 'further_info_url' attribute. All Priority=1 OMIP diagnostics (Omon, Oyr) are requested for all cycles of the 62-year forcing to quantify drift. All OMIP diagnostics (Priority=1,2,3) are requested for the last cycle

concepts.label: omip1-spunup
concepts.description: Same as the omip1 experiment except that it is not initialized with observed climatologies; rather it is initialized with results from at least a 2000-year spin up of the coupled physical-biogeochemical models. The spin up simulations may be made with the classic online or offline approach, or with tracer-acceleration techniques or fast solvers. If an online approach is used, at the end of the 5th cycle of CORE-II forcing, the model's physical fields should be reinitialized to the values at the start of the 3rd cycle in order to avoid long-term drift in those fields and to assure that they will not diverge greatly from physical fields in the omip1 simulation. The spin up also includes radiocarbon to evaluate deep-ocean circulation

concepts.label: omip2
concepts.description: Global ocean - sea-ice coupled experiment forced with the JRA55-do inter-annually varying atmospheric and river data sets for years 1958-2018. Initial ocean tracer fields are based on observations. Simulation length for at least 6 cycles of the 61-year forcing is required. The 6-cycle length is recommended to facilitate intercomparison within the experiment by using a common simulation length, but a longer simulation length is also accepted. In each simulation, set the beginning of the simulation (e.g., 1653 for the 6-cycle simulation) as the 'base time' of the time axis. Simulations with different simulation lengths by a single model are treated as members of an ensemble. Thus, different 'realization' indexes (e.g., r1, r2, r3, ...) should be used in a global attribute named 'variant_index' (e.g., r1i1p1f1). It is requested that information relevant to understanding the differences in members of an ensemble of simulations is reported in a global attribute named 'variant_info'. This information should also be recorded in the ES-DOC documentation of each experiment performed by a model and be made available via the 'further_info_url' attribute. All Priority=1 OMIP diagnostics (Omon, Oyr) are requested for all cycles of the 61-year forcing to quantify drift. All OMIP diagnostics (Priority=1,2,3) are requested for the last cycle

concepts.label: omip2-spunup
concepts.description: Same as the omip2 experiment except that it is not initialized with observed climatologies; rather it is initialized with results from at least a 2000-year spin up of the coupled physical-biogeochemical models. The spin up simulations may be made with the classic online or offline approach, or with tracer-acceleration techniques or fast solvers. If an online approach is used, at the end of the 6th cycle of the JRA55-do forcing, the model's physical fields should be reinitialized to the values at the start of the 4th cycle in order to avoid long-term drift in those fields and to assure that they will not diverge greatly from physical fields in the omip2 simulation. The spin up also includes radiocarbon to evaluate deep-ocean circulation

concepts.description: Early 19th century cluster of strong tropical volcanic eruptions, including the 1809 event of unknown location, the 1815 Tambora and 1835 Cosigueina eruptions. Experiment initialized from PiControl

concepts.label: volc-cluster-mill
concepts.description: Parallel experiment to volc-cluster-ctrl but with initial conditions taken from last millennium simulation to account for the effects of a more realistic history of past natural forcing. All forcings except volcanic kept constant from year AD 1790 on

concepts.label: volc-long-eq
concepts.description: Idealized equatorial eruption corresponding to an initial emission of 56.2 Tg of SO2. The eruption magnitude corresponds to recent estimates for the 1815 Tambora eruption (Sigl et al., 2015), the largest historical tropical eruption, which was linked to the so-called "year without a summer" in 1816. Experiment initialized from PiControl

concepts.label: volc-long-hlN
concepts.description: Idealized Northern Hemisphere high-latitude eruption emitting 28.1 Tg of SO2. Experiment initialized from PiControl

concepts.label: volc-long-hlS
concepts.description: Idealized Southern Hemisphere high-latitude eruption emitting 28.1 Tg of SO2. Experiment initialized from PiControl

concepts.label: volc-pinatubo-full
concepts.description: 1991 Pinatubo forcing as used in the CMIP6 historical simulations. Requires special diagnostics of radiative and latent heating rates. A large number of ensemble members is required to address internal atmospheric variability

concepts.label: volc-pinatubo-slab
concepts.description: As volc-pinatubo-full, but with a slab ocean

concepts.label: volc-pinatubo-strat
concepts.description: As volc-pinatubo-full, but with prescribed perturbation to the total (LW+SW) radiative heating rates

concepts.label: volc-pinatubo-surf
concepts.description: As volc-pinatubo-full, but with prescribed perturbation to the shortwave flux to mimic the attenuation of solar radiation by volcanic aerosols

concepts.label: yr2010CO2
concepts.description: Branch from beginning of year 2010 of the historical simulation with CO2 concentration and all other forcing held fixed at 2010 level (part of the CDR-yr2010-pulse experiment to diagnose CO2 emissions)
